doc_sha256_convention: sha256 of the .md bytes; G3 refuses an E* claim if the companion and the document disagree, so the prose stays the authority and this file cannot drift from it

E1.claim: the stable-prefix + append-only journal compiler (spcc) matches or beats bounded fetch on single-fact recall and beats masking everywhere, while costing no more billed tokens than masking
E1.design: 48-checkpoint fixture; arms spcc vs masking-no-fetch vs bounded-context-fetch; temperature 0, seed 42
E1.falsifier: spcc below fetch on single-fact, or spcc not strictly above masking on any checkpoint class, or billed tokens above masking

E2.claim: larger compaction interval lowers rewrite cost with no accuracy loss until the interval exceeds the distance at which facts stop being refetched
E2.design: COMPACT_EVERY in {12, 24, 48} on the same 48-checkpoint fixture and arm
E2.falsifier: cost does not fall monotonically, or accuracy drops before the predicted distance

E3.claim: the observed distance cliff is a property of position, not of eviction (body present)
E3.design: fact present at distances {2, 8, 20, 32, 64}, no eviction, both arms
E3.falsifier: neither outcome is clean (mixed cliff) -- would require re-running with finer distance grid

E4.claim: Nemotron Nano matches or exceeds occamy on contract-level scoring; all three models stay below the fetch ceiling on aggregation
E4.design: Nemotron Nano vs occamy-1.0 vs qwen3.5-9b on the same 48 checkpoints
E4.falsifier: Nemotron below occamy on contract-level (then keep occamy as measurement model)
E4.blocked_on: Nemotron weights on the remote host (serving/REMOTE-ROOT.md authorisation)

E5.claim: enabling SGLang hierarchical cache raises cached fraction and lowers billed tokens without hurting latency
E5.design: HiCache off vs on at identical prompts and context
E5.falsifier: cached fraction does not rise, or billed tokens do not fall, or latency regresses

E6.claim: one epoch of LoRA on generated pointer tasks yields a measurable contract-level gain on held-out checkpoints, or the training path is shelved
E6.design: LoRA Nano on generated pointer tasks, 1 epoch, evaluate on held-out checkpoints
E6.falsifier: no measurable gain -> shelve training path
E6.blocked_on: remote authorisation AND Nano LoRA under the 60 GB cgroup cap

rules: No payload-to-savings inference; billed tokens only, from the server's cache report.
Every cell records fixture_sha256, generation and prefix_sha256.
E6 runs only after E1-E5 and only if E1 shows spcc is a real arm.
